figures.caption: Figure 1. Overview of SPARK. A three-stage pipeline automatically constructs a KG from scientific documents, and Cross-Document Federation connects concept nodes across papers. A single sVLM alternates between Proposer and Solver roles: the Proposer samples reasoning paths from the KG to generate relational questions with gold answers, while the Solver answers without KG access, under information asymmetry. The reward signal decomposes into three KG-verified components, Ranswer, Rpath, and Rconsistency, where Rpath and Rconsistency are terms unique to SPARK that cannot be defined without the KG.

Figure 2. Overview of SPARK. Qualitative comparison of Qwen3-VL-4B vanilla and SPARK across three cases of increasing relational complexity. Both models receive identical inputs at inference time; differences arise solely from model weights.
